tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the full text of federal law: United States Code, Code of Federal Regulations, Public Laws, Congressional Bills, Executive Orders. Results are ranked across every corpus unless `corpus` narrows them, each with its citation, a link and the matching words. A query that is only a citation returns that document instead.

date.description: For a code, search it as it stood on this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

page.description: Page of results, 20 to a page.

query.description: Words, a "quoted phrase", NOT before a word to exclude it, or a citation.

title.description: For a code, search one title ("11", "40").

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read a document or page of the site as markdown: a code section with its notes, a title's or unit's contents, a public law, a bill (at any version), an executive order. Paths also reach the corpus indexes ("/usc", "/pl?congress=118", "/bills?congress=119", "/eo") and each code's releases ("/usc/releases"). Links in the markdown are paths this tool accepts.

citation.description: A citation ("26 U.S.C. 61(a)", "40 CFR 60.1", "Pub. L. 119-21", "H.R. 1", "E.O. 14000"). Give this or `path`.

notes.description: Include a section's source credit, notes and footnotes.

path.description: A page of the site, as its path or full URL ("/usc/26/61", "/pl/119/21"). Give this or `citation`.

provision.description: Part of the document: in a code section, a provision and everything under it ("a-1" for (a)(1)) or a run of them ("a..c"); in a law, bill or order, a heading's {#anchor} ("tI-stA-s10101") or a provision under it ("tI-stA-s10101-a").

release.description: For a code, the release to read it at: a release point ("119-21") or a date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the release in force then. Defaults to the latest.

tools.name: citations
tools.description: What cites a document: each corpus's citations of a code section, law, bill or order, with the words that cite it, and for a statute the regulations issued under it. Lists come 50 at a time; `list` and `offset` page through one.

citation.description: A citation ("26 U.S.C. 61(a)", "40 CFR 60.1", "Pub. L. 119-21", "H.R. 1", "E.O. 14000"). Give this or `path`.

list.description: One list only, by the corpus that cites.

offset.description: With `list`, where in it to start.

path.description: A page of the site, as its path or full URL ("/usc/26/61", "/pl/119/21"). Give this or `citation`.

tools.name: history
tools.description: How a document came to be: for a code section, the laws that enacted and amended it and every release that changed its text; for a law or bill, its legislative history, each version linked to its text and to what changed from the one before.

citation.description: A citation ("26 U.S.C. 61(a)", "40 CFR 60.1", "Pub. L. 119-21", "H.R. 1", "E.O. 14000"). Give this or `path`.

path.description: A page of the site, as its path or full URL ("/usc/26/61", "/pl/119/21"). Give this or `citation`.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: What changed in a code section between two releases: each provision added, removed, changed or renumbered, the edits marked <del> and <ins>. To compare versions of a bill, take the 'what changed' link from its history.

citation.description: A citation ("26 U.S.C. 61(a)", "40 CFR 60.1", "Pub. L. 119-21", "H.R. 1", "E.O. 14000"). Give this or `path`.

from.description: Release point or date to compare from. Defaults to the release before `to`.

only_edits.description: Only the provisions that changed, not the whole text.

path.description: A page of the site, as its path or full URL ("/usc/26/61", "/pl/119/21"). Give this or `citation`.

to.description: Release point or date to compare to. Defaults to the latest.
